Title: Rishabh's Day

Cast

1. Rishabh - 11 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Neeta - 42 years, mother
Look: blue saree, hair in a bun
3. Tanay - 8 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans
4. Savitri - 65 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair

Places

1. The park - green grass, swings, benches
2. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The park - Day

[Rishabh stands in the park. Neeta and Savitri stand near him.]

Savitri: "What lovely weather!"

[Rishabh kicks the football hard.]

Savitri: "Yes, all right."

[Rishabh plays cricket in the park.]

Neeta: "Okay, Rishabh."

[Rishabh goes down the slide.]

Neeta: "What next?"

[Rishabh plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Savitri: "I knew it!"

[Rishabh plays with his dog.]

Rishabh: "What next?"

[Rishabh feeds the birds.]

Savitri: "Let's see."

Scene 2: The courtyard - Day

[Rishabh stands in the courtyard. Neeta and Savitri stand near him.]

Savitri: "Let's begin."

[Rishabh feeds the dog.]

Neeta (laughing): "One more time!"

[Rishabh milks the cow.]

Savitri: "Really?"

[A cat walks along the wall.]

Savitri: "Good job, Rishabh!"

[Rishabh pats his horse.]

Savitri: "Let's do this again tomorrow!"
